newsitem.title: INDIA: India firm in pact with Commercial Union.
newsitem.headline: India firm in pact with Commercial Union.

text.p: India's Hindustan Times Ltd said on Monday it had signed an agreement with Britain's Commercial Union Assurance Co Plc to jointly develop a venture in the general insurance business.
Hindustan Times publishes Delhi's leading English language daily of the same name.

Shobhana Bhartia, executive director of Hindustan Times Ltd, signed a memorandum of understanding with James Rattray, director of Commercial Union, in anticipation of liberalisation of Indian insurance market, the statement said.
India says it intends to open up its insurance industry to priate firms under an economic reform programme launched five years ago, but it has yet to do so.
"The expected liberalisation of the insurance industry offers tremendous opportunities and we have identified it as a strategic growth area for expanding our business," Bhartia said.
Before the nationalisation of the Indian insurance sector in 1972, Commercial Union was the largest international insurer in India.
